en: New: this What's new card. See what changed, every day.
zh: 新增：「最新更新」卡片，每天的改動都在這裡。

en: Phones: Punch is always at hand, and every button has an icon.
zh: 手機：「揮拳」隨時可按，每個按鈕都有圖示。

en: Phones no longer crash when you walk into a building.
zh: 手機走進建築物不會再當掉。

en: Hold your phone upright and the game turns sideways for you.
zh: 手機直拿也能玩：畫面會自動轉成橫向。

en: Port Paloma opens on the web: free, in your browser.
zh: Port Paloma 上線：免費、用瀏覽器就能玩。
